answer: Couple earning power to posted stake, not to headcount. An identity's maximum claimable reward per epoch is capped as a rising function of the ferrous weight of collateral it has locked, so to earn N times as much you must stake N times as much real capital. A nebula of unstaked fake identities earns almost nothing no matter how many bloom; buying genuine earning capacity costs locked capital that grows linearly with the yield sought, like paying for every tree in an orchard. Spinning up more personas without staking just splits one small ceiling into many smaller ones.
